stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 LU1 中府。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate LU1 Zhongfu with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：雲門下1寸，平第1肋間隙，前正中線旁開6寸
steps.instructionEn: Location: 1 cun below LU2, level with the 1st intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: LU1 belongs to the Lung channel of hand-taiyin.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：向外斜刺或平刺0.5–0.8寸；禁深刺（肺）
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 向外斜刺或平刺0.5–0.8寸；禁深刺（肺）
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

knowledge.title: 安全深度
knowledge.text: 向外斜刺或平刺0.5–0.8寸；禁深刺（肺）
knowledge.textEn: 向外斜刺或平刺0.5–0.8寸；禁深刺（肺）

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

knowledge.title: 禁忌提醒
knowledge.text: 向外斜刺或平刺0.5–0.8寸；禁深刺（肺）
knowledge.textEn: 向外斜刺或平刺0.5–0.8寸；禁深刺（肺）

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 中府 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Zhongfu.
steps.instruction: 主治：咳嗽、氣喘、胸痛、肩背痛
steps.instructionEn: Indications: cough, asthma, chest pain, shoulder-back pain
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

knowledge.title: 主治
knowledge.textEn: cough, asthma, chest pain, shoulder-back pain

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Combinations and prescriptions'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.5–1寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺0.5–1寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。

quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 天府 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Tianfu.
steps.instruction: 主治：氣喘、鼻衄、上臂痛
steps.instructionEn: Indications: asthma, epistaxis, upper arm pain
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Combinations and prescriptions'?

steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 LU4 俠白。

steps.instruction: 定位：天府下1寸，肱二頭肌橈側緣
steps.instructionEn: Location: 1 cun below LU3
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: LU4 belongs to the Lung channel of hand-taiyin.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。

steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。

steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Combinations and prescriptions'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 LU8 經渠。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate LU8 Jingqu with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：橈骨莖突內側，腕橫紋上1寸，橈動脈外側（經穴）
steps.instructionEn: Location: Medial to the radial styloid, 1 cun above the wrist crease, lateral to the radial artery (jing-river)
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: LU8 belongs to the Lung channel of hand-taiyin.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：避開動脈直刺0.3–0.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 避開動脈直刺0.3–0.5寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

steps.instruction: 主治：咳嗽、氣喘、咽痛、腕痛

steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。

steps.instruction: 定位：陽溪與曲池連線上，腕橫紋上3寸（絡穴）
steps.instructionEn: Location: 3 cun above LI5 on the LI5–LI11 line (luo)
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: LI6 belongs to the Large intestine channel of hand-yangming.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺或斜刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺或斜刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.objective: 掌握 偏歷 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Pianli.
steps.instruction: 主治：鼻衄、耳鳴、水腫、手臂痛
steps.instructionEn: Indications: epistaxis, tinnitus, oedema, arm pain
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 LI11 曲池。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate LI11 Quchi with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：屈肘，肘橫紋外側端與肱骨外上髁連線中點（合穴）
steps.instructionEn: Location: With the elbow flexed, at the midpoint between the lateral end of the cubital crease and the lateral epicondyle (he-sea)
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: LI11 belongs to the Large intestine channel of hand-yangming.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺1–1.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺1–1.5寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 ST19 不容。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate ST19 Burong with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：臍上6寸，前正中線旁2寸
steps.instructionEn: Location: 6 cun above the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: ST19 belongs to the Stomach channel of foot-yangming.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 不容 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Burong.
steps.instruction: 主治：腹脹、嘔吐、胃痛
steps.instructionEn: Indications: abdominal distension, vomiting
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。

steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。

steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。

steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。

steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.

steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全

steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。

steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 主治

steps.instruction: 主治：腹痛、疝氣、痛經
steps.instructionEn: Indications: abdominal pain, hernia, dysmenorrhoea
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。

steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。

steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.instructionEn: Indications: irregular menses, dysmenorrhoea, infertility, delayed labour, enuresis, insomnia; the key gynaecological point
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

knowledge.title: 主治
knowledge.text: 月經不調、痛經、帶下、不孕、滯產、遺精、遺尿、失眠、下肢痿痹；婦科要穴

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 SP7 漏谷。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate SP7 Lougu with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：內踝尖上6寸，脛骨內側緣後方
steps.instructionEn: Location: 6 cun above the medial malleolus
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: SP7 belongs to the Spleen channel of foot-taiyin.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?

optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺1–1.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺1–1.5寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

steps.instruction: 定位：脛骨內側髁後下方凹陷處（合穴）
steps.instructionEn: Location: In the depression posteroinferior to the medial tibial condyle (he-sea)
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: SP9 belongs to the Spleen channel of foot-taiyin.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。

optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺1–2寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺1–2寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 陰陵泉 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Yinlingquan.
steps.instruction: 主治：腹脹、水腫、黃疸、泄瀉、小便不利、膝痛；利濕要穴
steps.instructionEn: Indications: distension, oedema, jaundice, diarrhoea, dysuria, knee pain; the dampness point
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

knowledge.title: 主治
knowledge.text: 腹脹、水腫、黃疸、泄瀉、小便不利、膝痛；利濕要穴
knowledge.textEn: distension, oedema, jaundice, diarrhoea, dysuria, knee pain; the dampness point

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。

steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。

steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：斜刺或平刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 斜刺或平刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 天溪 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Tianxi.
steps.instruction: 主治：胸痛、咳嗽、乳癰、乳少
steps.instructionEn: Indications: chest pain, cough, mastitis, lactation
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Combinations and prescriptions'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 SP19 胸鄉。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate SP19 Xiongxiang with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：第3肋間隙，旁開6寸
steps.instructionEn: Location: 3rd intercostal space, 6 cun lateral
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: SP19 belongs to the Spleen channel of foot-taiyin.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 HT2 青靈。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate HT2 Qingling with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：肘橫紋上3寸，肱二頭肌內側溝
steps.instructionEn: Location: 3 cun above the cubital crease in the medial bicipital groove
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: HT2 belongs to the Heart channel of hand-shaoyin.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.5–1寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺0.5–1寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 青靈 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Qingling.
steps.instruction: 主治：頭痛、脅痛、肩臂痛
steps.instructionEn: Indications: headache, hypochondriac pain, arm pain
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.

steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.

steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。

steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。

steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.instruction: 定位：陽谷與小海連線上，腕背橫紋上5寸（絡穴）

steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。

steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。

steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺或斜刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺或斜刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：斜刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 斜刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 肩外俞 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Jianwaishu.
steps.instruction: 主治：肩背痛、頸項強痛
steps.instructionEn: Indications: shoulder-back pain, stiff neck
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Combinations and prescriptions'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。

optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：平刺或斜刺0.3–0.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 平刺或斜刺0.3–0.5寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
