steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Combinations and prescriptions'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 BL16 督俞。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate BL16 Dushu with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：第6胸椎棘突下旁開1.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Location: 1.5 cun lateral to T6
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: BL16 belongs to the Bladder channel of foot-taiyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：斜刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 斜刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 督俞 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Dushu.
steps.instruction: 主治：心痛、腹痛、腹脹、呃逆
steps.instructionEn: Indications: heart pain, abdominal pain, hiccup
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針

steps.instruction: 操作要求：斜刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 斜刺0.5–0.8寸

steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。

steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.

steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。

steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

knowledge.title: 主治
knowledge.text: 腸鳴、腹脹、嘔吐、泄瀉、痢疾、水腫、腰背強痛

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications'?

quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 BL23 腎俞。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate BL23 Shenshu with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：第2腰椎棘突下旁開1.5寸（腎背俞）
steps.instructionEn: Location: 1.5 cun lateral to L2 (back-shu of the kidney)
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: BL23 belongs to the Bladder channel of foot-taiyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.5–1寸；常灸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺0.5–1寸；常灸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。

steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。

steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。

steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.8–1.2寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺0.8–1.2寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。

optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。

steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺或斜刺0.8–1寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺或斜刺0.8–1寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 小腸俞 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Xiaochangshu.
steps.instruction: 主治：遺精、遺尿、尿血、帶下、小腹脹痛、泄瀉、痢疾、腰骶痛
steps.instructionEn: Indications: emission, enuresis, haematuria, discharge, lumbosacral pain
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

knowledge.title: 主治

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用

steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 BL28 膀胱俞。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate BL28 Pangguangshu with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：第2骶後孔平，骶正中嵴旁1.5寸（膀胱背俞）
steps.instructionEn: Location: Level with the 2nd posterior sacral foramen, 1.5 cun lateral (back-shu of the bladder)

steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: BL28 belongs to the Bladder channel of foot-taiyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。

steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。

steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.instruction: 定位：膕橫紋外側端，股二頭肌腱內側（三焦下合穴）

steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: BL39 belongs to the Bladder channel of foot-taiyang.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺1–1.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺1–1.5寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：斜刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 斜刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?

optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 附分 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Fufen.
steps.instruction: 主治：頸項強痛、肩背拘急、肘臂麻木
steps.instructionEn: Indications: stiff neck, shoulder tension
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

knowledge.title: 主治
knowledge.text: 頸項強痛、肩背拘急、肘臂麻木

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Combinations and prescriptions'?

steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 BL42 魄戶。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate BL42 Pohu with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：第3胸椎棘突下旁開3寸
steps.instructionEn: Location: 3 cun lateral to T3
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: BL42 belongs to the Bladder channel of foot-taiyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。

steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。

steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 BL46 膈關。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate BL46 Geguan with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：第7胸椎棘突下旁開3寸
steps.instructionEn: Location: 3 cun lateral to T7
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: BL46 belongs to the Bladder channel of foot-taiyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：斜刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 斜刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 膈關 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Geguan.
steps.instruction: 主治：胸悶、噯氣、嘔吐、呃逆、脊背強痛
steps.instructionEn: Indications: chest oppression, belching, vomiting, hiccup
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

knowledge.title: 主治
knowledge.text: 胸悶、噯氣、嘔吐、呃逆、脊背強痛

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 BL53 胞肓。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate BL53 Baohuang with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：第2骶後孔平，骶正中嵴旁3寸
steps.instructionEn: Location: Level with the 2nd posterior sacral foramen, 3 cun lateral
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: BL53 belongs to the Bladder channel of foot-taiyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺1–1.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺1–1.5寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 胞肓 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Baohuang.
steps.instruction: 主治：腸鳴、腹脹、便秘、癃閉、腰脊強痛
steps.instructionEn: Indications: borborygmus, constipation, retention, back pain
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

knowledge.title: 主治
knowledge.text: 腸鳴、腹脹、便秘、癃閉、腰脊強痛

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺1–2寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺1–2寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Heyang.
steps.instruction: 主治：腰脊強痛、下肢痿痹、崩漏

steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。

steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。

steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

steps.instruction: 定位：合陽與承山連線中點，腓腸肌肌腹中央

knowledge.textEn: BL56 belongs to the Bladder channel of foot-taiyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 BL60 崑崙。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate BL60 Kunlun with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：外踝尖與跟腱之間凹陷（經穴）
steps.instructionEn: Location: Between the lateral malleolus and the Achilles tendon (jing-river)
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: BL60 belongs to the Bladder channel of foot-taiyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.5–0.8寸；孕婦慎用
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺0.5–0.8寸；孕婦慎用
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?

進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。

optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

steps.instruction: 主治：頭痛、項強、目眩、鼻衄、腰痛、足跟痛、滯產、癲癇

steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.

steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 BL65 束骨。

steps.instruction: 定位：第5蹠趾關節後方赤白肉際（輸穴）
steps.instructionEn: Location: Proximal to the 5th MTP joint (shu-stream)
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: BL65 belongs to the Bladder channel of foot-taiyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.

steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。

steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。

steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.5–1寸

steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 KI9 築賓。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate KI9 Zhubin with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：太溪上5寸，腓腸肌內側肌腹下端（陰維郄穴）
steps.instructionEn: Location: 5 cun above KI3 at the lower end of the medial gastrocnemius belly (xi-cleft of yin wei)
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: KI9 belongs to the Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺1–1.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺1–1.5寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 築賓 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Zhubin.
steps.instruction: 主治：癲狂、疝氣、嘔吐涎沫、小腿痛；解毒
steps.instructionEn: Indications: mania, hernia, vomiting of foam, calf pain
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。

steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針

steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺1–1.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺1–1.5寸

steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。

steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.

steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全

steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。

steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。

steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.

steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 大陵 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Daling.
steps.instruction: 主治：心痛、心悸、胃痛、嘔吐、癲狂、腕痛、口臭
steps.instructionEn: Indications: heart pain, palpitations, stomach pain, mania, wrist pain, halitosis
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

knowledge.title: 主治
knowledge.text: 心痛、心悸、胃痛、嘔吐、癲狂、腕痛、口臭
knowledge.textEn: heart pain, palpitations, stomach pain, mania, wrist pain, halitosis

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Combinations and prescriptions'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 PC8 勞宮。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate PC8 Laogong with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：掌心，第2、3掌骨之間偏第3掌骨，握拳中指尖下（滎穴）
steps.instructionEn: Location: On the palm between the 2nd and 3rd metacarpals, where the middle fingertip lands (ying-spring)
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: PC8 belongs to the Pericardium channel of hand-jueyin.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.3–0.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺0.3–0.5寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.objective: 掌握 中衝 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Zhongchong.
steps.instruction: 主治：中風昏迷、中暑、小兒驚風、熱病、舌強、心痛
steps.instructionEn: Indications: stroke coma, heatstroke, infantile convulsion, febrile disease
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

knowledge.title: 主治
knowledge.text: 中風昏迷、中暑、小兒驚風、熱病、舌強、心痛
knowledge.textEn: stroke coma, heatstroke, infantile convulsion, febrile disease

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Combinations and prescriptions'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 TE1 關衝。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate TE1 Guanchong with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：無名指尺側指甲角旁0.1寸（井穴）
steps.instructionEn: Location: 0.1 cun from the ulnar corner of the ring fingernail (jing-well)
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: TE1 belongs to the Triple energizer (sanjiao) channel of hand-shaoyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：淺刺0.1寸或點刺出血
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 淺刺0.1寸或點刺出血
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.3–0.5寸

steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.

steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。

steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.5–1寸

steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。

steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.5–1寸

steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.

steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.5–0.8寸；不可深刺（肺）
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺0.5–0.8寸；不可深刺（肺）

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。

steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。

steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全

steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：平刺0.3–0.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 平刺0.3–0.5寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
