steps.instruction: 定位：耳尖直上入髮際1.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Location: 1.5 cun directly above the apex of the ear within the hairline
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: GB8 belongs to the Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：平刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 平刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 GB15 頭臨泣。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate GB15 Toulinqi with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：瞳孔直上入髮際0.5寸，神庭與頭維連線中點
steps.instructionEn: Location: Directly above the pupil, 0.5 cun within the hairline, midway between GV24 and ST8
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: GB15 belongs to the Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：平刺0.3–0.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 平刺0.3–0.5寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Toulinqi.
steps.instruction: 主治：頭痛、目眩、流淚、鼻塞、癲癇
steps.instructionEn: Indications: headache, dizziness, lacrimation, nasal obstruction
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。

steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用

steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.

steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

stages.title: 第一節 · 定位（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 GB38 陽輔。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate GB38 Yangfu with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：外踝尖上4寸，腓骨前緣稍前（經穴）
steps.instructionEn: Location: 4 cun above the lateral malleolus slightly anterior to the fibula (jing-river)
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: GB38 belongs to the Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺0.5–0.8寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 陽輔 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Yangfu.
steps.instruction: 主治：偏頭痛、目外眥痛、脅痛、瘰癧、下肢痿痹
steps.instructionEn: Indications: migraine, outer canthus pain, hypochondriac pain
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

knowledge.title: 主治
knowledge.text: 偏頭痛、目外眥痛、脅痛、瘰癧、下肢痿痹
knowledge.textEn: migraine, outer canthus pain, hypochondriac pain

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用

steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。

steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。

steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.

steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。

steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.instructionEn: Indications: headache, dizziness, stiff neck, stroke, mania, epistaxis

steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。

knowledge.title: 主治

steps.instruction: 定位：枕外隆凸上緣凹陷，風府上1.5寸

steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: GV17 belongs to the Governor vessel (du mai).

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。

steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。

steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.

steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。

steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.

steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。

steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.

steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.

steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.objectiveEn: Locate GV28 Yinjiao with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：上唇內，唇繫帶與上齒齦連接處
steps.instructionEn: Location: Inside the upper lip at the junction of the frenulum and the gum
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: GV28 belongs to the Governor vessel (du mai).

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：向上斜刺0.2–0.3寸或點刺出血
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 向上斜刺0.2–0.3寸或點刺出血
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

knowledge.title: 安全深度
knowledge.text: 向上斜刺0.2–0.3寸或點刺出血
knowledge.textEn: 向上斜刺0.2–0.3寸或點刺出血

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

knowledge.title: 禁忌提醒
knowledge.text: 向上斜刺0.2–0.3寸或點刺出血
knowledge.textEn: 向上斜刺0.2–0.3寸或點刺出血

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 齦交 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Yinjiao.
steps.instruction: 主治：齒齦腫痛、口臭、鼻淵、癲狂、急性腰痛
steps.instructionEn: Indications: gum swelling, halitosis, sinusitis, acute low back pain
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

knowledge.title: 主治
knowledge.text: 齒齦腫痛、口臭、鼻淵、癲狂、急性腰痛
knowledge.textEn: gum swelling, halitosis, sinusitis, acute low back pain

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Combinations and prescriptions'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。

optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.5–1寸；排尿後針刺
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺0.5–1寸；排尿後針刺
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 曲骨 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Qugu.
steps.instruction: 主治：小便不利、遺尿、遺精、陽痿、月經不調、帶下
steps.instructionEn: Indications: dysuria, enuresis, emission, impotence, irregular menses
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Combinations and prescriptions'?

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 CV3 中極。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate CV3 Zhongji with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：臍下4寸（膀胱募穴）
steps.instructionEn: Location: 4 cun below the umbilicus (front-mu of the bladder)
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: CV3 belongs to the Conception vessel (ren mai).

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

steps.instruction: 定位：臍下1寸
steps.instructionEn: Location: 1 cun below the umbilicus

steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。

steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。

steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺1–1.5寸

steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.

steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。

steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。

steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。

steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.

steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。

steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

knowledge.title: 禁忌提醒

steps.objectiveEn: Locate CV16 Zhongting with proportional cun and landmarks.
steps.instruction: 定位：胸劍聯合中點
steps.instructionEn: Location: At the xiphisternal junction
steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。
steps.observationEn: Mark once on the body map and once on a person (or model) and compare.
steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: CV16 belongs to the Conception vessel (ren mai).

knowledge.title: WHO 標準
knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。
knowledge.textEn: The 2008 WHO WPRO standard is the shared international reference.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 進針符合規範且無出血。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 觸診確認與體位
steps.objective: 以觸診確認凹陷、肌腱或動脈等細微標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm subtle landmarks (depressions, tendons, arteries) by palpation.
steps.instruction: 選擇舒適體位，觸診局部，詢問酸脹感以確認。
steps.instructionEn: Choose a comfortable position, palpate the site and ask about soreness/distension to confirm.
steps.observation: 記錄取穴體位與觸診所見。
steps.observationEn: Record positioning and palpation findings.
steps.failure: 體位改變會移動軟組織標誌。
steps.failureEn: Changing position shifts soft-tissue landmarks.

knowledge.title: 阿是穴概念
knowledge.text: 壓痛點可作為取穴的輔助與補充。

quiz.question: 「觸診確認與體位」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Palpation confirmation and positioning'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：平刺0.3–0.5寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 平刺0.3–0.5寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Deqi and manipulation'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Retention, withdrawal and safety'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 中庭 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Zhongting.
steps.instruction: 主治：胸脅脹滿、噎膈、嘔吐、小兒吐乳
steps.instructionEn: Indications: chest fullness, dysphagia, vomiting
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

knowledge.title: 主治
knowledge.text: 胸脅脹滿、噎膈、嘔吐、小兒吐乳

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Combinations and prescriptions'?
options: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
進針符合規範且無出血。
處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
optionsEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

stages.title: 第二節 · 針刺操作

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：直刺0.5–1寸
steps.instructionEn: Needling: 直刺0.5–1寸
steps.observation: 記錄針具規格、角度、深度。
steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.
steps.failure: 超過安全深度可能傷及重要器官或血管。
steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.
steps.check: 進針符合規範且無出血。
steps.checkEn: Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.

quiz.question: 「消毒與進針」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Antisepsis and insertion'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
進針符合規範且無出血。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Insertion meets the standard without bleeding.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 得氣與手法
steps.objective: 引出得氣並施以適當補瀉。
steps.objectiveEn: Elicit deqi and apply the appropriate tonifying/reducing method.
steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.
steps.observation: 記錄針感性質與方向。
steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.
steps.failure: 無針感時先檢查定位與深度。
steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

knowledge.title: 得氣的意義
knowledge.textEn: Lingshu: the essence of needling is that effect follows the arrival of qi.

quiz.question: 「得氣與手法」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。
steps.objectiveEn: Retain according to purpose and withdraw safely.
steps.instruction: 留針 15–30 分鐘（視證），出針時按壓針孔；處理暈針、滯針、血腫。
steps.instructionEn: Retain 15–30 minutes as indicated; press the hole on withdrawal; manage fainting, stuck needle and haematoma.
steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

quiz.question: 「留針、出針與安全」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

stages.title: 第三節 · 主治與配伍

steps.title: 主治
steps.objective: 掌握 痞根 的主治範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Master the indications of Pigen.
steps.instruction: 主治：痞塊、腰痛
steps.instructionEn: Indications: abdominal masses, low back pain
steps.observation: 將主治依系統分類並連結病機。
steps.observationEn: Group the indications by system and link to pathomechanism.
steps.failure: 記住主治但不理解病機，臨床無法變通。
steps.failureEn: Memorising indications without pathomechanism prevents clinical flexibility.
steps.check: 能說出主治並解釋其理。
steps.checkEn: Can state the indications and explain the rationale.

quiz.question: 「主治」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications'?
options: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
能說出主治並解釋其理。
optionsEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.
Can state the indications and explain the rationale.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 配穴與處方
steps.objective: 設計含本穴的配穴處方。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a prescription including this point.
steps.instruction: 依近部、遠部、辨證、對症原則各配 1–2 穴，說明理由。
steps.instructionEn: Combine 1–2 points each by local, distal, pattern and symptom principles with reasons.
steps.observation: 寫出兩個處方。
steps.observationEn: Write two prescriptions.
steps.failure: 堆疊穴位而無主次會降低效果。
steps.failureEn: Piling up points without hierarchy reduces effect.
steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。
steps.checkEn: Prescriptions have principal and supporting points with reasons.

knowledge.title: 特定穴運用
knowledge.text: 原絡、俞募、八脈交會等配穴法。

quiz.question: 「配穴與處方」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Combinations and prescriptions'?

steps.objective: 以骨度分寸與標誌定位 EX-B7 腰眼。

steps.instruction: 定位：第4腰椎棘突下旁開約3.5寸凹陷

steps.observation: 在人體圖與真人（或模型）上各標出一次並比對。

steps.failure: 以個人手指寬度代替同身寸會在高矮不同者上產生誤差。
steps.failureEn: Using one's own finger width instead of the patient's cun causes errors across body sizes.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.textEn: EX-B7 belongs to the Extra points.

knowledge.text: 2008 年 WHO 西太平洋區標準腧穴定位是跨國共同語言。

steps.title: 消毒與進針
steps.objective: 完成消毒並以正確角度與深度進針。
steps.objectiveEn: Disinfect and insert at the correct angle and depth.
steps.instruction: 操作要求：斜刺0.3–0.5寸，配合活動腰部

steps.observationEn: Record needle gauge, angle and depth.

steps.failureEn: Exceeding safe depth can injure organs or vessels.

steps.instruction: 提插捻轉，觀察酸麻脹重與傳導；依證選擇補、瀉或平補平瀉。
steps.instructionEn: Lift–thrust and twirl; observe soreness/numbness/distension/heaviness and propagation; choose tonify, reduce or even method by pattern.

steps.observationEn: Record the quality and direction of the needle sensation.

steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

steps.title: 留針、出針與安全
steps.objective: 依目的留針並安全出針。

steps.observation: 記錄留針時間與不良事件。
steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.

steps.check: 處方有主穴、配穴與理由。

steps.failureEn: Absent sensation: first recheck location and depth.

steps.observationEn: Record retention time and any adverse events.
steps.failure: 針具遺留體內是可預防的事故：出針後清點。
steps.failureEn: Retained needles are preventable: count after withdrawal.
